<function name="IsButtonDown" parent="input" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
Gets whether the specified button code is down.

Unlike <page>input.IsKeyDown</page> this can also detect joystick presses from <page>Enums/JOYSTICK</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="button" type="number{BUTTON_CODE}">The button, valid values are in the range of <page>Enums/BUTTON_CODE</page>.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Is the button down?</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
